capabilities: Chat with an OpenAI-compatible model about selected text or images via right-click
Ground answers in folder-scoped lexical retrieval with citation links and flagged suspects
Branch conversations and revisit earlier questions in a question tree
Park unasked questions in a pending list
Edit answer excerpts into a draft and save it to the vault on confirmation
disambiguation: Not a general AI chat sidebar; it anchors every question to selected text or an image and only writes drafts you explicitly confirm.
extras: Distributed as manual release files (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css) rather than through the community plugin store; the listing itself carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. Includes a bilingual English/Chinese README.
motivation: The author says general chatbots answer from memory, so they built one that answers from your notes and reading state and keeps the question tree, pending list, and confirmed excerpts traceable.
problem: General chatbots answer from model memory and there is no built-in way to ask questions about a selection with answers citing your own notes and controlled vault writes.

requires.name: Web search provider (Kimi, GLM, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Serper, SearXNG)

summary: AI chat grounded in selected note text that answers from your allowed note folders and writes only excerpts you confirm to the vault.
